description: NSW Transport Theme - Traffic Control Device is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This data is maintained by the DCS Spatial Services. If you have any questions with regards to this dataset, please contact Traffic control devices are used to control, calm, slow or impede the movement of traffic. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are NSW Transport Theme, Traffic control, cattlegrid, device, gate. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTPS. The portal shows 2025-06-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
